papers.title_en: Who Is Sycophantic to Whom? Confident LLMs, Human Deference, and the Collapse of Trust Calibration
papers.authors: Deepthika S, Pawni Yadav, B. Sankar
papers.evidence: 实证检验用户是否会服从自信但错误的模型回答
papers.tldr: 大模型的迎合研究通常关注模型顺从用户，本文反问：当模型自信且持续出错时，人是否会顺从模型？研究让32名参与者与同一模型构建的五种助手学习科学知识，将事实篡改比例设为0至100%，并测量答题表现与信心。测验均分从7.4降至2.9分，约65%的已陈述错误被采纳，错误信念仍获高信心，而总体信任几乎不变。论文提出人类顺从指数，主张双向评估迎合，并在具体论断层面呈现可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Research on sycophancy asks whether large language models (LLMs) bend towards what their users want to hear. We ask the reverse question: when an LLM is confident, consistent, and wrong, do users bend towards it? In a within-subjects experiment, 32 participants learned up to five science topics by chatting with five assistants built on the same model (GPT-5-mini). Unknown to participants, each assistant's briefing had 0, 25, 50, 75, or 100% of its facts replaced by plausible falsehoods, and every assistant spoke with full confidence. A surprise quiz after each topic offered the correct fact, the planted falsehood, and two distractors, with a confidence rating for every answer. Across 104 quizzes and 1,040 answers, scores fell from 7.4 to 2.9 out of 10, and the planted option was chosen on 60% of falsified items against 11% of correctly taught ones (odds ratio 12.5). Transcript coding showed that whenever the assistant stated a falsehood, it was adopted about 65% of the time at every falsification level. Absorbed falsehoods were held with high confidence (8.4/10), the modeled confidence advantage of right over wrong answers vanished, and the discrimination of confidence for correctness fell from an AUROC of 0.70 to chance, while post-task trust ratings barely moved. Participants tended to return to the chat more when the assistant was worse, but returning went with more absorption, not less, and 30% of all turns pasted quiz questions back to the source being checked. The assistant itself was almost never sycophantic and never conceded under pushback. We introduce a baseline-corrected Human Deference Index to quantify this human-side sycophancy and argue that trustworthiness is a property of the human-AI pair, that sycophancy evaluations should measure both directions, and that learning interfaces must make reliability legible claim by claim.

papers.title_en: Learning to Remember: Advances in Memory Mechanisms for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Chenye Han, Hongche Yu, Mengyue Wu, Dell Zhang, Jixiang Luo
papers.evidence: 综述延展语言模型助手与智能体长期交互能力的记忆机制
papers.tldr: 大语言模型受限于固定上下文、无状态交互与静态参数知识，难以持续积累经验。本文从记忆生命周期、存储载体和智能体系统角色三个维度，梳理非参数记忆、参数记忆与面向智能体演化的记忆。综述覆盖构建、维护、检索、巩固、遗忘与治理，并将评估作为跨机制环节，而非独立记忆机制。其贡献是超越检索增强生成和长上下文视角，为持久、自适应、可审计且可安全更新的智能体提供设计路线图。
papers.abstract_en: Memory has become a central mechanism for extending large language models (LLMs) beyond fixed context windows, stateless interaction, and static parametric knowledge. This survey organizes the literature around three complementary dimensions: the life cycle of memory, the storage substrate, and the system role that memory plays in LLM-based agents, while using cognitive-science-inspired memory concepts as a lightweight conceptual motivation rather than as a separate technical contribution or implementation family. On this basis, we distinguish three mechanism families: nonparametric memory, where information is stored outside model parameters in text, graph, multimodal, or database-like structures; parametric memory, where information is stored or accessed through activations, key-value caches, learned modules, adapter-based parameterizations, or model weights; and memory for agent evolution, where stored experiences support reinforcement learning, continual learning, procedural reuse, context engineering, and agent harness design. Evaluation is treated as a separate cross-cutting component rather than as a memory mechanism. Unlike surveys that focus primarily on retrieval-augmented generation or long-context modeling, this paper emphasizes the full memory life cycle: construction, maintenance, retrieval, consolidation, forgetting, governance, and evaluation. By aligning conceptual motivations, computational memory mechanisms, benchmarks, and deployment concerns, the survey provides a structured roadmap for designing memory-augmented LLM agents that are persistent, adaptive, auditable, and safe to update over time.

papers.title_en: Knowing When to Escalate: Disagreement Patterns for Uncertainty-Aware Content Moderation
papers.evidence: 为语言模型智能体内容审核与升级处理提出不确定性感知方法
papers.tldr: 多智能体内容审核通常通过投票或共识消除分歧，但价值敏感任务中的分歧可能源于不可消解的价值多元性。论文提出推理轨迹分歧分析，将不同视角智能体的判断理由嵌入表示，并按理由相似度与结论一致性划分四种状态。在仇恨言论语料的1000条样本上，“理由相近但结论不同”的结构信号比仅看分歧幅度或输出的基线更能预测人工标注分歧。研究据此主张按分歧结构触发人工复核，而非一味追求共识。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic content-moderation systems increasingly rely on collective judgments from LLM agents, while aggregation methods commonly treat inter-agent disagreement as a reliability problem to be removed through consensus or voting. This framing is inappropriate for value-laden tasks, where disagreement may reflect irreducible value pluralism - a distinction standard uncertainty decompositions cannot recover, since they operate on output distributions and discard the reasoning behind each judgment. We propose Reasoning Trace Divergence Analysis (RTDA), which embeds model-generated justifications from perspective-differentiated agents and classifies each case by justification similarity and conclusion agreement. The resulting four-state taxonomy isolates convergent disagreement, where agents reasoning similarly but concluding differently, as a candidate signature of value-laden conflict. On 1,000 items from the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, this structural signal predicts human annotator disagreement better than magnitude-only and output-only baselines. We contribute a design principle: condition human escalation on the structure of disagreement, not its magnitude alone, with RTDA serving as a post-processing layer for systems that already generate reasoning traces.

papers.title_en: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Xinying Qian, Ying Zhang, Yu Zhao, Xubo Liu, Baohang Zhou, Jeff Z. Pan
papers.evidence: 直接研究大语言模型对话助手的长期记忆与个性化互动
papers.tldr: 长期对话记忆常将事件、情感与时间混入粗粒度单元，且依赖语义相似性组织，难以准确捕捉用户经历和偏好。ETAMem提取原子记忆并识别情感信息，构建事件、情感、时间三种层次视图，以自适应阈值增量维护，再按查询通过熵分配检索预算。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上，准确率相对提升12.46%和7.96%，同时保持有竞争力的令牌效率。结果支持按信息特征解耦、组织和检索长期记忆的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.

papers.title_en: The As-If Machine: Personalized counterfactuals make distant policy risks feel close
papers.authors: Joshua Ashkinaze, Yubo Zhou, Pengyu Chen, Avi Bhattacharya, Hyebin Park, Yanman Zhang, Stephanie Preston, Eric Gilbert, Ceren Budak
papers.evidence: 研究个性化AI叙事对公众政策态度的影响
papers.tldr: 人们难以支持应对未曾亲历风险的政策，而个性化叙事又难以规模化生产。研究提出多智能体系统AIM，让参与者共同撰写不同政策未来下自身生活的反事实故事。在科学资助与卫星网络安全两项预注册实验中，相比专家短文，风险心理接近感分别提高0.36和0.38个标准差，但政策态度变化因议题而异。结果表明，人机共写可让遥远风险变得切身，却不必然带来稳定的政策支持变化。
papers.abstract_en: Life experiences can shape policy attitudes, but we only live one life. Citizens may therefore fail to support policies addressing risks they have never personally experienced. Narratives can make such risks immediate and personal, but personalized stories remain difficult to produce at scale. Here we ask whether AI can make distant scenarios feel concrete by simulating a participant's life as if that scenario occurred. We present the As-If Machine (AIM), a multi-agent system through which people co-write personalized counterfactual narratives---stories about their own lives under different policy futures. In two pre-registered and quota-matched experiments on science funding (N=1,007) and satellite cybersecurity (N=894), we compared AIM with two controls: reading an expert-written vignette on the same topic and co-writing with AIM about an unrelated topic. AIM increased psychological closeness---how close a risk feels to the self---by nearly identical margins in the two domains (0.36 and 0.38 standard deviations (SDs) against the vignette, 0.80 and 0.90 against unrelated writing). AIM increased psychological closeness even among participants with unfavorable views of AI. For policy attitudes, AIM's effects were 0.16 SDs against the vignette and 0.10 SDs (n.s.) against unrelated writing for science funding; the corresponding effects for satellite cybersecurity were 0.54 and 0.67 SDs. Across 23,496 human-AI autocomplete interactions, participants and the system played distinct roles: AIM supplied concrete detail that grounded the scenario, and participants supplied first-person perspective and emotion. Co-writing with the As-If Machine makes distant policy risks feel close.

papers.title_en: Toward Neuroadaptive Communication Interfaces: A Framework for Personalized Speech and Language Support
papers.evidence: 依据行为反馈动态调整个性化沟通支持
papers.tldr: 现有言语与语言辅助技术多采用固定支持，难以适应用户能力差异及任务需求变化。本文提出个性化沟通框架，将消息获取、需求估计与支持选择分离，以行为反馈为主要依据，动态选择分句、图符和语音输出，并将脑电作为考虑不确定性的补充信息。论文提出固定界面、行为自适应与神经自适应的分阶段比较方案，尚未报告实证效果。核心贡献是明确检验脑电能否在强行为基线之上进一步改善理解与沟通效率。
papers.abstract_en: Speech and language technologies have expanded access to communication, but the support they provide is often fixed. The same linguistic or visual aid may help one user and hinder another, or become less useful as task demands change. This project proposes a framework for adapting language presentation to individual abilities and ongoing interaction. It separates access to a message from the estimation of user needs and from the selection of support, including sentence segmentation, pictograms, and optional spoken output. Behavioral feedback provides the primary evidence for adaptation; electroencephalography is considered an additional, uncertainty-aware source of information rather than a direct measure of comprehension. We specify a staged evaluation comparing fixed, behavior-adaptive, and neuroadaptive interfaces. The central question is whether neural information improves comprehension and communication efficiency beyond a strong behavioral baseline.

papers.title_en: Networked Humanoid Intelligence: Communication, Coordination, Collaboration, and Social Interaction
papers.authors: Loc X. Nguyen, Huy Q. Le, Ji Su Yoon, Nguyen H. Tran, Eui-Nam Huh, Choong Seon Hong
papers.evidence: 综述人形机器人与人类的沟通、协调和协作
papers.tldr: 人形机器人正从单机实验走向联网集群，但现有研究仍偏重个体能力，难以覆盖跨机器人与人类的信息交互。本文围绕通信、协调、协作及社会交互四类功能，沿架构、信息、物理耦合、时间尺度、系统规模和具身性六个维度梳理文献。综述区分真实与仿真人形机器人的证据，以及其他平台研究的适用边界，并分析信息过时和不安全知识传播等联网风险。由此提出控制感知网络、具身知识共享和可问责人工监督等研究方向。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots are moving from laboratory platforms toward connected fleets that share workspaces, infrastructure, tasks, and knowledge with other robots and humans. As deployments grow, the operation and improvement of each humanoid depend on information exchanged across the network. However, existing research has largely studied humanoids as individual systems. This survey examines networked humanoid intelligence through four functions of information exchange: communication, coordination, collaboration, and social intelligence with human interaction. We first establish the foundations of networked humanoid systems, define the question addressed by each function, and connect them through a common factory scenario. We review the literature along six dimensions: interaction architecture, exchanged information, physical coupling, operating timescale, system scale, and embodiment. We separate results obtained with physical and simulated humanoids from those based on other robotic platforms or disembodied agents, because the latter do not fully capture humanoid-specific constraints such as balance, whole-body motion, contact, and physical interaction. We examine hardware, datasets, and benchmarks, and distinguish risks handled locally from those networking introduces, such as stale information or unsafe knowledge propagation. Finally, we identify open problems in control-aware networking, compact body-centric messages, physically grounded coordination, network- and embodiment-aware knowledge sharing, fleet-level social consistency, and accountable human oversight.

papers.title_en: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yongxiang Hu, Ruiyang Liu, Qining He, Xuan Wang, Yangfan Zhou
papers.evidence: 解决智能体在图形界面和移动设备上的滑动探索与操作可靠性
papers.tldr: 图形界面视口有限，任务目标常隐藏在屏幕之外，智能体在需要滑动探索时有47.8%的情况误选点击。论文提出在动作选择前引入可滚动区域感知，基于人工收集的667个界面训练多模态模型Hagasu。该模型正确识别78.5%的可滚动区域，接入九种智能体后，探索依赖任务的平均完成率从64.8%升至82.7%。研究表明，显式感知隐藏内容的探索入口有助于提升任务执行可靠性，并开放数据与代码。
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. To this end, we trained the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception on a manually collected dataset of 667 UI screens, called Hagasu. By correctly identifying 78.5% of scrollable regions, experiments across nine GUI agents show that integrating Hagasu improves the mean end-to-end completion rate from 64.8% to 82.7% on explore-dependent tasks. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the swipe dataset and the source code of Hagasu.

papers.title_en: From Voiceprints to User Entities: Online Speaker-Memory Construction for Multi-User Spoken Agents
papers.authors: Yucong Zhang, Cancan Li, Bo Xiao, Ke Zeng, Ming Li
papers.evidence: 为个性化语音智能体构建持久的用户专属记忆
papers.tldr: 多用户语音助手必须先识别说话人，才能正确读写个人记忆，但固定声纹难以适应长期声学变化。论文提出免训练的EvoSpeakerMem，通过在线说话人路由、门控声学更新和身份分区维护持久用户实体，并构建LoCoMo-ID基准。相较固定表示，门控更新在干净与条件偏移场景下分别提升身份门控问答3.86和11.62个百分点，未出现错误用户授权。研究同时揭示，问答改善与跨用户错误关联可能并存，需联合评估记忆碎片化和污染。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized spoken agents must identify speakers before accessing user-specific memory, yet memory benchmarks typically assume correctly attributed histories. We argue that voiceprints are observations of identity, not identities themselves, and formulate online speaker-memory construction to maintain persistent user entities as acoustic evidence evolves. We introduce EvoSpeakerMem, a training-free layer for causal speaker routing, selective acoustic-state updates, and identity-partitioned memory writes and retrieval through a replaceable text-memory backend. We also construct LoCoMo-ID, a spoken-memory benchmark with hidden speaker identities, speaker-sensitive queries, simulated recording-condition shifts, and four-speaker identity-confusion tests. On longitudinal SMIIP-TV, genuine-probe rejection under a frozen near-enrollment threshold rises from 29.8% to 55.6% over approximately one year. On LoCoMo-ID speaker-sensitive queries, gated updating improves identity-gated QA over fixed representations by 3.86 and 11.62 percentage points under clean and shifted conditions, respectively, with no wrong-user authorizations. The advantage persists in the four-speaker test. Yet reducing fragmentation and improving QA can coexist with incorrect cross-user links, revealing a fragmentation--contamination trade-off that QA alone cannot capture.

papers.title_en: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
papers.authors: Chanwoo Park, Jaywoong Jeong, Zachary Wojtowicz, Yubin Kim, Taekyun Lee, Kaiqing Zhang, Asuman Ozdaglar
papers.evidence: 评估智能体整合团队成员分散信息的协作决策能力
papers.tldr: 现实决策常依赖成员整合分散信息，但现有智能体主要接受单体训练与评测。TeamGym从法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料构建团队决策任务，通过识别各自必要、合起来充分的关键事实，控制信息分布并追踪整合过程。对8个模型、12套语料的评测显示，信息分散使成功率平均下降22.9个百分点，自行检索再降低19.9个百分点。仅用最终决策奖励进行强化学习即可改善决策并诱发协作，为诊断和训练团队能力提供环境。
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team's success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.

papers.title_en: Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
papers.authors: Minqian Liu, Yuexi Shen, Heajun An, Qi Zhang, Pamela J. Wisniewski, Sang Won Lee, Jin-Hee Cho, Lifu Huang
papers.evidence: 通过心理真实的被说服者模拟训练大模型进行策略性说服
papers.tldr: 多轮策略性说服既缺乏心理机制可信的模拟对象，也难以从稀疏的结果奖励中判断各轮对话的贡献。论文构建可呈现非单调态度变化的PersuArena，并提出Probe-RPO，每轮从冻结被说服模型的输出概率中读取三类内省探针，生成密集过程奖励。在医疗、金融等五类场景中，完全接受率达52.5%，高于最强GRPO消融版本的35.8%。研究展示了利用交互对象隐含信念训练说服策略的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee's internal state into dense process rewards. At each turn, three introspective probes are read from the frozen persuadee's logits, yielding a multi-dimensional reward signal that is faithfully aligned with persuasion dynamics. With extensive experiments on PersuArena spanning healthcare, financial advising, workplace management, education, and personal relationships, we demonstrate that our Probe-RPO achieves the full acceptance rate of 52.5%, compared with the 35.8% for the strongest GRPO ablation and 25.8% for the best off-the-shelf LLM. We also conduct comprehensive analyses on the generalization across persuadee models and the persuasion dynamics across conversations. Our work offers a promising paradigm that can provide effective process supervision for strategic dialogue.

papers.title_en: Jointly Modeling Preferences and Imperfect Decision-Making in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Axel Abels, Elias Fernández Domingos, Tom Lenaerts
papers.evidence: 建模大语言模型在经济与社会选择情境中的偏好和策略行为
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在偏好测验中表现出的倾向，能否预测其面对个人、群体与环境利益冲突时的决策，仍不清楚。论文提出偏好—行为模型，通过逆博弈联合推断偏好与非完美效用最大化参数，并在三类社会困境中检验。结果发现，传统测验估计的偏好不能稳定预测行为，而单一困境中拟合的模型对其他困境仍有预测价值。该方法还能识别人设指令与行为偏好的契合及偏离，为评估偏好一致性和目标对齐提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Do preferences Large Language Models (LLMs) express in standard elicitation tasks predict their strategic behaviour? LLM agents interacting with humans and other AI systems face potentially conflicting objectives, such as individual welfare, group welfare, and environmental concerns. Prior work characterizes LLM preferences through behavioral-economic and psychological elicitation or strategic games, but rarely tests consistency across settings and prediction in other strategic environments. This requires modeling how competing objectives jointly shape behavior, whereas existing approaches typically measure preference dimensions in isolation. Drawing on utility theory, we introduce the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization. We formulate estimation as an inverse-game problem, jointly inferring preferences and behavioral parameters from observed choices. We evaluate PBM in three social dilemmas that expose conflicting motives: a Public Goods Game, a Collective-Risk Dilemma, and a Common-Pool Resource dilemma. We find that while preferences estimated from established behavioral economic elicitation instruments do not consistently predict behavior in these dilemmas, models fitted in one dilemma retain predictive value in others, suggesting that inferred preferences capture meaningful aspects of LLM decision-making that elicitation instruments may miss. Finally, we assess alignment with persona instructions, finding that inferred preferences broadly reflect intended priorities with specific divergences across dimensions, LLMs, and games being identified by our approach. Our methodology provides a framework for studying how consistently LLM preferences explain behavior, assessing alignment with intended priorities, and revealing trade-offs and behavioral patterns that standard elicitation may miss.

papers.title_en: OS-Wizard: Scaling Computer-Using Agents to Specialized Software via Knowledge-Guided Exploration
papers.authors: Zhoumianze Liu, Zichen Ding, Bowen Yang, Zehao Li, Zhenyu Wu, Yibo Zhao, Kanzhi Chen, Yian Wang, Yanan Sun, Qiushi Sun, Yu Qiao
papers.evidence: 研究计算机使用智能体在专业软件中的图形界面与代码交互轨迹
papers.tldr: 专用桌面软件缺少高质量交互轨迹，应用知识不足、界面流程繁琐和探索覆盖有限阻碍了自动采集。OS-Wizard结合教程引导、图形界面与代码混合动作，以及关键状态回访，自动探索不同工作流。框架采集1.09万条轨迹和5.49万个状态—动作样本，微调后专用任务成功率达64.1%，提升58.2个百分点。模型在仅用图形界面的通用桌面任务上也有提升，表明专用软件数据可带来跨任务收益。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents are increasingly capable of performing complex tasks in the digital world. However, high-quality interaction trajectories remain scarce for specialized desktop applications, where limited application knowledge, cumbersome GUI workflows, and incomplete exploration hinder automated collection. We introduce OS-Wizard, an automated trajectory collection framework. It combines tutorial-guided exploration with a hybrid GUI--Code action space, providing application-specific knowledge and simplifying GUI workflows through direct execution of application-native commands. The framework also checkpoints and revisits pivotal states during tree exploration to explore alternative workflows, complementing linear rollouts for broader coverage. We collect 10.9K trajectories comprising 54.9K state--action samples. Fine-tuning open-source base models on this corpus yields a best-performing model that improves performance on a benchmark of specialized desktop workflows by 58.2 percentage points to 64.1\%, surpassing reported human performance of 59.8\% and establishing a new state of the art. The fine-tuned model also improves performance on general desktop workflows using GUI actions only, suggesting that the collected supervision benefits general desktop tasks as well. Comparative experiments and ablations demonstrate the efficiency of trajectory collection and the importance of code actions.

papers.title_en: Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLMs
papers.authors: Siddhesh Pawar, Chen Cecilia Liu, Anna Korhonen, Isabelle Augenstein
papers.evidence: 考察大语言模型价值训练的意外影响及其对价值对齐的启示
papers.tldr: 大语言模型日益用于价值敏感场景，但现有价值对齐评估范围较窄，难以发现定向训练对其他行为的影响。研究对四个指令微调模型分别开展霍夫斯泰德价值维度训练，评估跨价值迁移及更广泛的行为变化。结果发现，单一价值训练不仅改变未训练的价值偏好，还影响风险偏好、社会认知与安全相关特征。研究提示，价值对齐不能只看目标价值是否达成，还需扩大行为评估范围，并研究额外价值训练在训练流程中的适宜位置。
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede's value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.

papers.title_en: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Yalun Wu, Qiwei Ma, Bingbing Xu, Dan Zhang, Long Bai, Boyang Wang, Jiatong Li, Zheqi Lv, Shaozu Yuan, Peiying Wang, Jiawei Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua
papers.evidence: 去中心化语言模型智能体在合作与混合动机的多智能体互动中适应策略
papers.tldr: 去中心化多智能体需要在合作、混合动机和对抗交互中适应其他智能体，但现有方法多针对特定场景，难以统一支持即时适应与经验复用。EvolveMAS为每个主智能体配备独立记忆智能体，在单次交互中更新结构化记忆，并跨交互提炼伙伴画像与互动策略。在五个基准、六种评测配置中，其归一化平均得分为77.2，位居对比方法首位。该框架无需更新模型参数，为跨场景、经验驱动的多智能体自演化提供统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized multi-agent systems (MAS) enable large language model agents to interact without centralized control. Agents need to adapt to other agents at test time and reuse accumulated experience to refine their interaction strategies for future interactions across cooperative, mixed-motive, and adversarial settings. However, existing approaches often develop adaptation mechanisms for particular interaction settings. This raises a central question: how can decentralized MAS support test-time adaptation and reliable experience reuse across interaction settings? We propose EvolveMAS, a unified self-evolution framework that supports experience-driven adaptation within and across episodes. EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent for test-time memory governance, which maintains isolated Structured Memory outside the main agent's reasoning context. EvolveMAS organizes adaptation into two complementary processes: Within-Episode Online Adaptation and Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution. During Within-Episode Online Adaptation, MemoryAgent updates episodic, semantic, and working memory from interaction evidence to inform subsequent actions. During Cross-Episode Knowledge Evolution, the main agent uses memory and episode outcomes to distill reusable interaction knowledge comprising partner profiles and interaction strategies for subsequent episodes. Across five benchmarks and six evaluation configurations spanning the three interaction settings, EvolveMAS achieves the highest normalized average score of 77.2 among the compared methods. Ablations show that test-time memory governance and cross-episode knowledge reuse both improve performance. Interaction traces further illustrate how updated memory and distilled knowledge guide subsequent interactions. These results support experience-driven adaptation in decentralized MAS without updating model parameters.

papers.title_en: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team, Yuechen Luo, Chong He, Fang Li, Shaoqing Xu, Jingkai Wang, Menglun Su, Jiaxin Liu, Shengyin Jiang, Zhiyi Lai, Long Chen, Longlong Wang, Liang Hu, Haochen Liu, Yuncheng Jiang, Hongwei Xie, Jieming Cui, Hanbing Li, Junjie Huang, Zhixiang Duan, Hexin Zhang, Weixiang Liang, Ying Gong, Yuhan Wang, Yong Pan, Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Ken Deng, Kun Ma, Fuxi Wen, Zhi-xin Yang, Hangjun Ye
papers.evidence: 具身智能体整合任务理解、规划、进度追踪与反馈驱动的恢复。
papers.tldr: 通用具身机器人需要在长时程任务中协调操作与导航，并持续跟踪进度、从失败中恢复。OmniBrain-0以共享高层决策模型统一这些能力，通过具身预训练、领域专家蒸馏和多教师在策略蒸馏，将强教师的交互经验压缩进轻量模型。研究还引入评分准则引导的递归自改进，利用执行证据更新专家并重新整合。模型在多个仿真基准及真实操作任务中表现较强，相比闭源教师降低推理与执行开销，展示了跨领域具身决策能力的高效整合。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning for Dyadic Relationship Recognition
papers.authors: Wang Tang, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Linbo Qing, Ce Zhu, Hatice Gunes
papers.evidence: 融合行为与情感线索推理双人多模态互动关系
papers.tldr: 双人社会关系识别需要从多模态互动中推断潜在关系，但现有方法通常统一融合线索并进行扁平分类，忽略不同关系依赖不同互动模式。HiRe-DRR按特征层级、互动类型和关系层次组织证据，通过稀疏专家路由筛选相关互动，并以层次条件损失实现由粗到细的监督。在三个基准上，该方法优于近期代表性方法。路由分析还显示，疏远关系更依赖低层同质互动，亲近关系更依赖高层异质互动，为差异化关系推理提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Dyadic relationship recognition aims to identify the latent social relationship between two individuals from their multimodal interactions. Existing methods typically project heterogeneous cues into a shared representation and optimise a flat classification objective, overlooking that relationships may rely on different interaction patterns. For instance, distant relationships can often be inferred from direct behavioural correspondence, whereas close relationships are better reflected by coordinated affective, behavioural, and multimodal responses. To address this limitation, we propose HiRe-DRR, a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning framework that organises relationship evidence from three complementary perspectives: feature level, interaction type, and relationship hierarchy. HiRe-DRR decomposes facial, bodily, acoustic, and textual cues into low- and high-level representations and constructs homogeneous and heterogeneous cross-participant interactions. We further introduce the Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer (MoI-Former), which treats diverse interactions as specialised experts and employs relation-aware sparse routing to identify relationship-relevant evidence while preserving contextual interaction information. The proposed Hierarchical Conditional Loss (HC-Loss) exploits the hierarchical nature of social relationships through coarse-to-fine supervision, enabling structured relationship reasoning. Extensive experiments on three dyadic relationship benchmarks demonstrate that HiRe-DRR outperforms recent representative image-, video-, and multimodal methods. Our routing analysis further reveals that distant relationships tend to rely on low-level homogeneous interactions, whereas closer relationships focus on high-level heterogeneous interactions. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tw-repository/HiRe-DRR.

papers.title_en: PsyJev: Psychological Analysis via System-1 Judgment
papers.authors: Fangyuan Liu, Sirui Zhao, Xiaohao Wang, Guo Cheng, Peng Zhang, Enhong Chen
papers.evidence: 分析网络自我披露中的心理与症状相关信息
papers.tldr: 网络自我披露可用于多种心理分析，但不同任务的标签语义与判断标准难以统一。论文构建涵盖六类心理领域、13个数据集和82个问题的PsyJudgeBench，提出按问题直接输出答案分布的PsyJev，通过联合监督训练与判断锚定强化优化学习共享判断能力。基于Qwen3.5的9B模型平均测试F1达67.56，超过最强外部对比模型2.54个百分点。该工作以统一接口保留各任务标准，为异构心理内容分析提供共享建模方案。
papers.abstract_en: Self-disclosures on the Web support diverse psychological analyses, from recognizing expressed experiences to identifying symptom-relevant information. We study a shared, question-conditioned decision interface for this heterogeneous problem in content analysis. We organize PsyJudgeBench, comprising 13 annotated datasets and 82 questions across six psychological areas, while preserving source-specific criteria and masks for unobserved labels. We introduce PsyJev, a System-1 model that directly produces distributions over answers specified in each request. Joint supervised training establishes the shared judgment function, followed by Judgment-Anchored RLCD (JA-RLCD), which adapts logit-space reward optimization to heterogeneous psychological judgments through balanced supervision, selective retention of correct SFT predictions, and question-group reward optimization. The Qwen3.5-based 2B, 4B, and 9B models achieve 64.33, 66.21, and 67.56 average test F1, respectively. The 9B model exceeds the strongest external comparison by 2.54 points. Controlled 2B comparisons examine the training stages and anchored refinement. Further analyses examine question-conditioned judgment, inference cost, and probability quality, complemented by qualitative comparisons across models.

papers.title_en: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
papers.authors: Qiaoling Chen, Jiaxiang Cheng, Xueqing Deng, Tiankai Hang, Ji Hou, Jiaqi Li, Yifan Liu, Tao Lu, Junshu Tang, Yu Tang, Yao Teng, Yu Tian, Heng Wang, Weizhi Wang, Xiyao Wang, Xilun Wu, Mingyu Yang, Yangbin Yu, Rui Zhao, Longjun Cao, Linghao Chen, Haoyi Duan, Jiaming Han, Mingji Han, Enhua Jiang, Shunkai Li, Yanzhe Liang, Qinwei Ma, Cong Wang, Lei Wang, Bing Wu, Ke Xing, Ray Ying, Zhentao Yu, Key Zhang, Yuan Zhou, Zhengguang Zhou, Kai Zou
papers.evidence: 支持通过文本和镜头控制多轮交互生成世界
papers.tldr: 交互式世界生成需要连续响应用户指令，同时保留历史状态与动作后果。Hy-Nomas采用80亿参数扩散骨干，将结构化视频描述与动作感知因果注意力对齐，使场景描述跨片段保留、动作指令仅在目标时段生效。视觉语言提示增强器整合请求与交互历史，支持多轮自由文本、连续相机控制和变长视频生成。论文报告其人工评测优于现有世界模型，并开放权重、代码、基准与轻量适配流程，以支持可复现研究。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.
